Fill in the form completely and paste a recent passport-size photograph with your signature in the box on the form.
If you are employed, get a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from your present employer.
Address the email to The Director, Zoological Survey of India, Kolkata, with the subject line "APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF ………" and the post name filled in.
Send the filled application, and the NOC if you are employed, to [email protected] on or before 30 October 2026.
Fill in the Google Form at https://forms.gle/Qo96cjU4vRvP2dyR6 correctly and before the last date. ZSI uses it for primary screening, and it is mandatory for all candidates.
No hard copy of the application is required.

content_sections.heading: About ZSI
content_sections.text: The Zoological Survey of India (ZSI) is an organisation of the Government of India under the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change. Its Director is in Kolkata, and it has a headquarters, regional centres and field sites. These posts serve its project on "Documentation of traditional knowledge in wildlife conservation". The notice invites Indian citizens to work with ZSI as Consultants and Project Associate II.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice advertises 3 posts: 2 Consultant posts and 1 Project Associate-II post. Its table prints one figure, 02, for Consultant A, B and C together. Each consultant applicant is assessed under the category (A, B or C) that fits their qualifications and experience. The Director, ZSI, keeps the right to select any number of candidates, even though the notice gives a number of vacancies. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The posts are open to Indian citizens. Candidates must be physically fit to travel to different parts of the country, including remote areas, to document traditional knowledge related to wildlife conservation. Essential: (i) Master's degree in Science or Arts as the minimum qualification, with good knowledge of M.S. Office; (ii) experience in the relevant field for more than three and up to five years; (iii) publications in peer-reviewed journals. OR: Retired Government Employees with (i) Grade pay of Rs. 4600/- and above and good knowledge of M.S. Office, and (ii) experience in the relevant field for more than three and up to five years. Desired: Experience in interdisciplinary research involving Archeology, Ecology, Anthropology, History and Conservation Biology; experience in data analysis of questionnaires, interviews, folklore, oral histories and traditional narrative; experience in graphic designing and wildlife-related artwork illustrations. Essential: (i) Master's degree in Science or Arts as the minimum qualification, with good knowledge of M.S. Office; (ii) experience in the relevant field for more than five and up to ten years; (iii) publications in peer-reviewed journals. OR: Retired Government Employees with (i) Grade pay of Rs. 6600/- and above and good knowledge of M.S. Office, and (ii) experience in the relevant field for more than five and up to ten years. Desired: Experience in interdisciplinary research involving Archeology, Ecology, Anthropology, History and Conservation Biology; experience in data analysis of questionnaires, interviews, folklore, oral histories and traditional narrative; experience in graphic designing and wildlife-related artwork illustrations; Generative AI and large language models for document summarization, classification, translation and knowledge extraction. Essential: (i) Master's degree in Science/Arts/ PhD from a recognized university and more than 10 years up to 15 years of experience in Research/ Development/ Design/ Academic/ Government Institutions/ Organisations in environment/ Forestry/ Archeology/ Anthropology/ Large Data Analyst; experience in scientific publication, project management and interdisciplinary collaborations. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Consultant posts carry consolidated pay of ₹60,000 (A), ₹80,000 (B) and ₹1,00,000 (C) per month. The PA-II post carries ₹35,000 + HRA. House rent allowance is allowed as per the rules of Govt. of India/ ZSI. It can never exceed the rates payable to Central Government employees in that area. HRA is calculated on the actual stipend of the Research Fellow. The stipend of a research fellow is exempt from income tax under 10(16) of the IT Act. The positions are purely temporary, for a period of 14 months or till the completion of the project. The engagement of Consultants is also governed by the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change guidelines for consultants. These were issued vide OM No. A. 65013/7/2018-P.II dated 22.09.2020, with related instructions and amendments. Selection, payment of funds, use of the contingent grant, progress reports, tenure, publications, patents, leave and similar matters follow the general rules for SPA & PAs as per the rules of MoEFCC.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 Consultant posts across Consultant A, B and C, and 1 Project Associate-II post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026, both for emailing the application to [email protected] and for filling the mandatory Google Form.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the ZSI Project Associate-II post?
faq.answer: You need an M.A. in Arts (Archeology/ History/other relevant subjects) from a recognized institute/University. You also need two years of research experience in Academic/Research Institutions after the Master's degree.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ZSI Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Consultant A and B need a Master's degree in Science or Arts with good knowledge of M.S. Office and publications in peer-reviewed journals, plus more than 3 to 5 years (A) or more than 5 to 10 years (B) of experience. Consultant C needs a Master's degree in Science/Arts/ PhD with more than 10 to 15 years of experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 65 years for Consultant (A/B/C) and 35 years for PA-II, counted up to the last date of the application. Relaxation for SC/ST, OBC and physically handicapped candidates applies to the PA-II post only, as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for ZSI Consultant and PA-II posts?
faq.answer: Consultant A gets ₹60,000, Consultant B ₹80,000 and Consultant C ₹1,00,000 per month, all consolidated. Project Associate-II gets ₹35,000 + HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: HRA is added only to the Project Associate-II pay of ₹35,000. It follows Govt. of India/ZSI rules and never exceeds the rate payable to Central Government employees in that area. The Consultant pay is consolidated.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for ZSI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form, with an NOC if you are employed, to [email protected] by 30 October 2026. Also fill the mandatory Google Form at https://forms.gle/Qo96cjU4vRvP2dyR6. No hard copy is required.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: ZSI shortlists candidates on their qualification and experience, and uses the Google Form for primary screening. Shortlisted candidates are told by email/WhatsApp to appear before an interview committee virtually or in hybrid mode.

faq.question: Q10. Can retired government employees apply for ZSI Consultant posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Retired government employees can apply if they meet the grade pay and experience required for each post. Consultant A needs grade pay of Rs. 4600/- and above with more than 3 to 5 years of experience. Consultant B needs Rs. 6600/- and above with more than 5 to 10 years. Consultant C needs Rs. 8700/- and above with more than 10 to 15 years.
